messages.subject: [Genabel-announce] DatABEL v0.9-5 released on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
Dear GenABEL users,

A new version of DatABEL has just been published on CRAN.

The most important changes in DatABEL v0.9-5 are two fixed bugs:
- Fixed bug #5793: impute2DatABEL gives several errors [1]
- Fixed bug #1126: Using mach2databel() or impute2mach() to convert
files to the filevector format leaves fvtmp files behind [2]

Thanks to all who contributed to this release and special thanks to
Maksim Struchalin for preparing the CRAN submission.
If you find any bugs, please report them in our bug tracker on R-Forge [3].


Best regards,

Lennart Karssen.


[1]
https://r-forge.r-project.org/tracker/index.php?func=detail&aid=5793&group_id=505&atid=2058
[2]
https://r-forge.r-project.org/tracker/index.php?func=detail&aid=1126&group_id=505&atid=2058
[3]
https://r-forge.r-project.org/tracker/?func=browse&group_id=505&atid=2058
--
